title: pyrus esfandiarii
intro: Pyrus esfandiarii, commonly known as the Iranian wild pear, is a species of pear tree native to Iran. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation. The health benefits of Pyrus esfandiarii include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus esfandiarii, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, exhibit therapeutic actions including antimicrobial, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerogenic effects.
